item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 06/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry continental airstream will bring mainly fine weather to Guangdong in the next couple of days. With a relatively humid easterly airstream affecting the coast of Guangdong, it will be cloudier with a few rain patches, and relatively warm over the region during the weekend and early next week. A fresh to strong northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China midweek next week.
